selection_rationale: Official Scientific Reports article describes large blood-film images with coordinates and labels for cells.
Official source states free access to more than 40000 normal WBC images.
The dataset explicitly supports detection, localization, classification, and segmentation research tasks.
Raabin-WBC is more directly aligned with leukocyte candidate localization than derivative mixed-cell detection datasets.

candidates.version: Scientific Reports 2022 release; exact downloadable archive version not locally verified
candidates.license: Article is CC BY 4.0. Official Raabin page states free access for commercial and non-commercial projects. Dataset archive license must be rechecked after download before redistribution.
candidates.number_of_images: about 23000 blood-film images before cell extraction; official page also describes more than 40000 WBC images
candidates.number_of_annotated_leukocytes: not stated as leukocyte-only in audited pages; article reports about 43000 blood elements obtained after extraction
candidates.image_resolutions: not fully audited; article describes 512x512 square crops around cell centers and large non-cropped images
candidates.annotation_format: JSON dictionaries per microscopic image according to article
candidates.segmentation_masks_available: available for 1145 selected cells: nuclei and cytoplasm ground truths
candidates.staining: peripheral blood films; exact stain field not confirmed in audited lines
candidates.acquisition_devices: Olympus CX18 and Zeiss microscopes at 100x; smartphone cameras documented in article
candidates.single_cell_vs_full_field_image_status: full/large blood-film images with coordinates and labels are described; cropped cells also exist

candidates.number_of_annotated_leukocytes: not separately stated in audited README; 18143 boxes for WBC, RBC, and platelets combined
candidates.patient_or_sample_ids: metadata file described; patient/sample IDs not confirmed
candidates.single_cell_vs_full_field_image_status: peripheral blood cell detection images aggregated from public sources
